title: LLMs Don't Know What They Know: Benchmarking Temporal Self-Knowledge for Financial Backtesting
excerpt: Financial backtests of large language models (LLMs) are meaningful only if the model did not already know the outcomes it is asked to predict. Practitioners guard against this by trusting a vendor's stated knowledge cutoff, by asking the model what it knows, or by instructing it to answer as of a past date. To verify whether any of these safeguards can be trusted, we introduce FinDendro, a benchmark of 2,226 dated U.S. facts from 1999 to 2026, covering monthly macroeconomic series, month-end stock prices and Federal Reserve decisions. excerpt: LLM pruning must preserve quality while meeting hardware- and workload-specific constraints on latency, throughput, and memory. excerpt: Streaming speech recognition is increasingly consumed by machines, such as translators and voice agents, that act on each token as it appears. title: EvoWorld: Towards Out-of-Sight World Evolution in Generative Video Models
excerpt: Generative video models are increasingly used as visual world simulators, yet their primary strength lies in rendering plausible pixels rather than reasoning about how a world should evolve. For example, after a wild beast appears, the model should not only depict the wild beast, but also infer whether a nearby person should flee, take cover, or fight back based on the realized scene. excerpt: Autoregressive decoding relies on the KV cache, whose memory footprint grows linearly with context length and caps batch size and throughput. title: Locating the source of a mysterious beep with Claude
excerpt:
Our house has a box room, full of boxes that we still haven't unpacked from our last move. A couple of weeks ago something in that room started intermittently beeping . The beeps were far enough apart that standing in the room and trying to determine the source of the noise was frustrating, and I really didn't want to dig through every one of those boxes. So I had Claude Code build Beep Locator , a software system for triangulating the source of a mysterious beep using multiple devices scattered around the room.
